parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: DatabaseType
parameters.description:
The type of the database. Valid values:

- **MYSQL**
- **MSSQL**
- **Oracle**.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the ECS instance.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: QueryType
parameters.description:
The query type for the database. Valid values:

- **create**: create
- **restore**: restore.

parameters.name: UniRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the database server.
